portal.alpha: Alpha – desktop builds for Windows, macOS and Linux are unsigned; your OS will ask before the first start.
portal.calc.text: Formulas with an Excel-compatible engine, cell styles, number formats and fill – saved as .xlsx.
portal.description: Rusuite – a small office suite with a Rust core: Calc, Write and Show, in your browser and on the desktop.
portal.lead: A small office suite with a Rust core – runs in your browser and on the desktop.
portal.privacy.browser: Calc, Write and Show keep autosave copies of unsaved changes and a list of recently used files (with a copy of each document) in this browser's own storage (IndexedDB), plus your language and settings (localStorage). This data is private to this browser profile on this device; it is not synced to other browsers or devices. In every app, File › Home › Privacy lets you remove these local copies, or stop keeping autosave copies. Clearing the site data in your browser settings removes everything as well.
portal.privacy.desktop: The desktop builds keep the same data in the app's data folder of your user account and make no network connections of their own.
portal.privacy.lead: Rusuite keeps your documents on your own device. This page says what is stored where.
portal.privacy.sentence: Your documents never leave your device: there is no server-side storage, no tracking and no analytics. Privacy details
portal.privacy.server: Nothing about you or your documents. The server only hands out the static program files; it has no database, no upload and no account. The only request a page makes besides loading its own files is /version.json (the build number shown in the footer). The server's web log records ordinary requests (time, address, page) like any web server; documents are never part of them.
portal.privacy.title: Privacy – Rusuite
portal.privacy.tracking: None. No cookies, no analytics, no advertising, no fonts or scripts from other sites. A Content Security Policy makes your browser refuse connections to any other host.
portal.show.text: Layouts, shapes, pictures, speaker notes and a presenter view – saved as .pptx.
portal.sub: Opens and saves real .xlsx, .docx and .pptx files. Nothing to install, no account, your files stay on your machine.
portal.title: Rusuite – Calc, Write and Show
portal.write.text: Styles, lists, tables, images, headers and footers with a page view – saved as .docx.
portal.privacy.connections: Calc, Write and Show can open and save files on a WebDAV server you use – Nextcloud, ownCloud, a NAS or a hosted drive – once you add one under File › Open › Add a connection…. Nothing happens until you do: Rusuite offers no cloud of its own, registers no provider apps and no Rusuite server is involved. The only host contacted is the server you configured, directly from your browser or desktop app, and only when you browse, open or save there. The connection and – only if you tick “Remember password on this device” – its password stay on this device (in the browser's storage, unencrypted; on the desktop the app's data folder and the system keyring). File › Home › Privacy › Forget all connections removes them. In the browser the server must allow requests from this site (CORS: Nextcloud and ownCloud need this site's address in their CORS settings), and this site's security policy currently allows no other hosts, so for now connections work in the desktop apps.
